author: White Oak Creators Guild
title: Looking for 12 artists for 2028 calendar landscapes
content:
🚨 ANNOUNCEMENT 🚨
Calling all fine artists! Today we launch a new White Oak collective art project, a calender for 2028. 

We are looking for 12 different artists who will each create a full color landscape painting, with theming particular to the month it will be attached to.

1. Each artist will be paid 50 dollars for their completed piece.
2. Hand drawn or digital art is acceptable, but no generative AI will be allowed. We want to see each artist embracing their own voice and creativity authentically.
3. Each submission must be a new and original new piece made specifically for the calendar.

DM us directly or email us at WhiteOakCreators@protonmail.com to contact us and pick the month you would like to undertake.
